post.title: My approach to the class competition
post.description: My approach first splits each text into two spans and extracts features, along with TF-IDF word and character n-gram similarities and I also used Sentence Transformer  embeddings to capture both writing habits and deeper meaning. These combined features are then fed into an XGBoost model to predict whether the two texts were written by the same author.
